jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Netherlands
jobs.description:
What We're Looking For:

- Expertise in GAAP: Strong knowledge of Dutch GAAP and U.S. GAAP.

- Global Experience: Experience in a global organization is highly preferred.

- Language Skills: Fluent in Dutch and English.

- Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Organizational Skills: Highly organized with the ability to multi-task and meet strict deadlines.

- Tech Savvy: Proficient in advanced Excel and enterprise systems, preferably Oracle Financial Software.

Why Join Us?

- Dynamic Environment: Be part of a rapidly evolving industry.

- Professional Growth: Gain exposure to a broad range of financial activities at a U.S. publicly-traded company.

- Collaborative Team: Work with a motivated and supportive team.

- Flexible Work Conditions: Enjoy a climate-controlled office environment with minimal travel requirements.

Ready to Apply? If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for finance and accounting, we want to hear from you! Join us at American Tower and take your career to new heights.
Qualifications:

- Education: Degree in Accounting/Finance.

- Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of accounting experience.

- Preferred Background: Combination of public accounting, financial holding environment, and industry experience.
What You'll Do:

- Journal Entries & Accounts Payable: Record journal entries and manage accounts payable.

- Reporting Cycles: Assist in monthly internal and external reporting for all Netherlands entities.

- Balance Sheet Analysis: Review, maintain, and analyze balance sheet account reconciliations.

- Tax Returns & Reporting: Prepare and file Dutch tax returns (VAT and CIT) and DNB reporting.

- Annual Financial Reports: Assist in preparing annual financial reports and supporting schedules.

- Intercompany Reconciliations: Perform intercompany reconciliations and ensure timely clearance.

- Maintain Records: Keep accurate books and records for Netherlands entities, including fundings and capital contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
The Team

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Specialist to join American Tower’s Marketing team. The Marketing team impacts lead generation and new sales opportunities through our digital campaigns, social media, trade shows and sales enablement materials. This role will support the execution, optimization, and measurement of integrated digital marketing programs. Key areas of impact include marketing automation, CRM campaign management, paid digital advertising, web analytics, and customer journey analysis to help improve campaign performance and business impact.
What You Need to Succeed

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, demand generation, marketing automation, marketing technology, or a related function.

- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Email deliverability, and CAN-SPAM/CASL/GDPR compliance; Experience developing and testing e-mails, landing pages, and forms.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, Salesforce reporting, or similar platforms.

- Hands-on experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, paid search, paid social, display, retargeting, sponsored content, or lead generation advertising.

- Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar systems.

- Experience using web analytics and campaign tracking tools to measure digital performance, conversions, attribution, and customer journey activity.

- Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations.

- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.

- Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.

- Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the agreed upon timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.
What You Can Offer Us

- Build, launch, and optimize multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across email, web, paid media, landing pages, webinars, events, and nurture programs.

- Support marketing automation and CRM campaign operations, including lead scoring, lead routing, segmentation, campaign workflows, Salesforce Campaigns, and data quality.

- Coordinate paid digital advertising programs across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and related platforms, including audience targeting, campaign setup, budget pacing, testing, and performance optimization.

- Track the full digital customer journey from first touch through website engagement, form conversion, lead creation, nurture progression, sales handoff, opportunity influence, and closed-loop reporting.

- Use web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms to evaluate traffic sources, user behavior, content engagement, conversions, and campaign effectiveness.

- Develop and maintain campaign tracking standards, including UTM parameters, conversion events, source tracking, attribution logic, and reporting documentation.

- Create dashboards and recurring reports covering campaign performance, paid media results, web analytics, attribution, funnel progression, budget use, and actionable optimization recommendations.

- Partner with Marketing, Sales Operations, Business Intelligence, Digital, vendors, and agency partners to align campaigns, reporting, technology, and business objectives.

- Identify opportunities to improve campaign processes, MarTech integrations, lead quality, conversion rates, customer journey visibility, and operational efficiency.

- Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Land Negotiations
jobs.description:
The Team
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager, Land Negotiations to join American Tower’s Property Management organization’s Land Negotiations team. The team focuses on global land negotiations vendor management, transaction productivity, asset protection, and financial performance. Day to day you will oversee the United States land negotiations vendor channel, manage vendor activity and deal pipelines, monitor performance, and improve program efficiency. As a Senior Program Manager, Land Negotiations, you will partner with cross-functional and regional teams to standardize vendor management, align resources with business priorities, and implement strategic initiatives.
What You Need to Succeed
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required, with a concentration in Economics or Finance strongly preferred
- A minimum of 10 years of program management, real estate, real estate contract negotiation, or other related experience required.
- Experience supervising, training, and onboarding team members in business development, acquisitions, or a similar function preferred.
- Ability to understand financial models and concepts.
- Proficiency in managing and reporting on large data sets using Microsoft Office applications or other software.
- Proficiency in Salesforce systems, system development, reporting, and dashboards.
- Project Management Professional certification preferred.
- Fluency in English required; multilingual capabilities preferred.
- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively
What You Can Offer Us
- Own a portfolio of work and serve as the United States land negotiations vendor program’s subject matter expert.
- Drive program goals, maximize transaction close conversions, and train cross-functional teams that support the program.
- Create automations to reduce cycle times and manual handling of vendor transactions in the United States.
-  Manage day-to-day vendor activities, enhance outreach touchpoints, build and oversee a deal funnel, and audit closed transactions for commission payment accuracy.
- Develop and execute the global vendor management strategy in alignment with regional business priorities, asset protection objectives, and financial targets.
- Manage a global vendor budget of $20 million, direct vendor and product spending based on analytics and key performance indicator achievement, and partner with regional teams to manage more than 7,000 transactions and $120 million in global capital expenditure.
- Establish global vendor performance standards, scorecards, and key performance indicators to drive accountability, productivity, and consistent results across markets.
- Design and administer vendor incentive and compensation programs that drive desired behaviors, increase transaction volume, and maximize financial returns.
- Partner with regional Land Negotiations leaders to forecast vendor capacity, prioritize workloads, and optimize resource allocation against annual business objectives.
- Identify and execute opportunities to improve program efficiency and financial performance, and implement changes that support program success.
- Define program risks and partner with internal groups and project teams to develop proactive risk-mitigation and contingency strategies; conduct periodic training to support production, productivity, efficiency, readiness, and compliance.
-  Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Supply Chain Strategy
jobs.description:
The Team
We are seeking a Senior Specialist, Supply Chain Excellence to join American Tower’s Supply Chain Management organization’s Supply Chain Strategy team. The team focuses on global supply chain standardization, governance, analytics, reporting, process improvement, compliance, and scalable execution across sourcing, procurement operations, logistics, and related supply chain processes. Day to day you will develop reporting routines, analyze operational data, maintain governance documents, support process improvements, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, and translate supply chain performance information into actionable insights.
As a Senior Specialist, you will strengthen performance visibility, improve data and reporting discipline, support adoption of standardized practices, and help advance continuous improvement across the global supply chain function.
What You Need to Succeed
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, Engineering, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
- A minimum of 5 years of supply chain, sourcing, procurement operations, logistics, analytics, governance, operational excellence, and/or related process improvement experience required.
- Strong knowledge of sourcing, procurement operations, purchase-to-pay, supplier performance, logistics, transportation, warehousing, freight cost, service metrics, controls, and compliance requirements required.
- Demonstrated ability to build key performance indicator dashboards, scorecards, executive summaries, variance analysis, reporting packages, and performance review materials required.
- Experience developing policies, governance frameworks, standard operating procedures, process documentation, controls, data standards, and compliance routines required.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, business intelligence and reporting tools, and enterprise resource planning, procurement, source-to-pay, logistics, inventory, finance, and/or analytics systems required.
- Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, stakeholder management, communication, documentation, project and program management, learning agility, artificial intelligence fluency, and change adoption skills required.
- Fluency in English required; multilingual capabilities preferred.
- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
- Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
- Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the agreed upon timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.
What You Can Offer Us
- Support global supply chain excellence initiatives across sourcing, procurement operations, logistics, supplier performance, cost management, service levels, and compliance.
- Develop and maintain key performance indicator frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, data definitions, reporting templates, and performance review routines that provide actionable visibility into risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.
- Analyze data from enterprise resource planning, source-to-pay, procurement, logistics, inventory, finance, and business intelligence platforms to identify root causes, cost drivers, service exceptions, process gaps, and operational variances.
- Apply artificial intelligence-enabled tools, automation, and emerging analytics methods to improve reporting efficiency, data preparation, root cause analysis, policy management, workflow support, and decision quality.
- Develop and maintain supply chain policies, governance documents, standard operating procedures, control frameworks, and compliance guidance for sourcing, procurement operations, and logistics.
- Partner with sourcing, procurement, logistics, finance, IT, business enablement, compliance, and regional teams to improve spend visibility, supplier and logistics performance, contract compliance, purchase-to-pay performance, data integrity, and reporting automation.
- Translate complex data and operational findings into executive-ready insights, business cases, corrective actions, and practical recommendations.
- Maintain the Global Supply Chain Portal as a central information hub and gateway for business users to access supply chain services, guidance, tools, resources, and support channels.
- Support standardization and continuous improvement projects by mapping current-state processes, defining future-state requirements, coordinating action plans, measuring benefits, and supporting adoption.
- Support Supply Chain Sustainability data and reporting, including data governance, metric definitions, reporting accuracy, performance visibility, and stakeholder-ready insights that support sustainability commitments and decision-making.
- Other duties as assigned.
